name: Jebel Ali Port
role: Largest port in the Middle East; DP World flagship; ~9th-busiest container port globally. Major Asia-Europe transshipment hub.
primary_routes: East Asia (China) | South Asia (India) | Europe | East Africa | Americas

name: Khalifa Port
role: Abu Dhabi flagship deep-water port (AD Ports/KIZAD); semi-automated; containers plus petrochemical & aluminium exports.
primary_routes: East Asia | Europe | US East Coast | Indian subcontinent

name: Zayed Port
role: Older Abu Dhabi city port; container ops moved to Khalifa; now cruise, general and breakbulk cargo.

name: Port Rashid
role: Dubai's original port; cargo shifted to Jebel Ali; now primarily a cruise terminal.

name: Port of Fujairah
role: World's #2 bunkering hub and major oil-storage terminal. Sits OUTSIDE Hormuz on the Gulf of Oman - the strategic release valve when the strait is disrupted. Most important port for disruption early-warning.
primary_routes: Global tanker traffic | oil to Asia & Europe | bunkering

name: Khor Fakkan Container Terminal
role: Deep natural harbour; major container transshipment hub; bypasses Hormuz on the Gulf of Oman.
primary_routes: Asia-Europe mainline | feeder services to Gulf ports

name: Khalid Port
role: Sharjah's main Gulf-coast container and general cargo port.

name: Hamriyah Port
role: Free-zone port; oil & gas services, petrochemicals, heavy industrial exports.

name: Ajman Port
role: Serves Ajman Free Zone; general cargo, containers, regional trade.

name: Mina Saqr
role: Northernmost UAE port, closest to the strait; bulk exports - aggregates, cement, limestone (RAK building-materials).
primary_routes: Regional bulk | building materials to South Asia & Gulf

name: Jebel Dhanna / Ruwais Terminal
role: Major ADNOC crude loading terminal serving Ruwais; one of the UAE's largest oil export points.
primary_routes: Crude to East Asia | India | Europe

name: Das Island Terminal
role: Offshore ADNOC oil & LNG export island; loads crude and liquefied gas directly for export.
primary_routes: Crude & LNG to East Asia (Japan, Korea)

name: Zirku Island Terminal
role: Offshore crude processing and export terminal (Upper Zakum / offshore fields).
